results.title: U.S. Natural Gas Is Supplying Energy to the World: August 2026 Summary | Department of Energy
results.snippet:
In August 2026, Europe received 269.3 Bcf of U.S. LNG, accounting for 52.3 percent of total U.S. LNG exports. Egypt was the largest individual destination for the third month in a row, receiving 55.9 Bcf.
